description: Use this when the user asks whether a UPC, EAN, GTIN-8/12/13/14, SSCC, ISBN-10/13 or ISSN number is valid, what its check digit should be, or wants to convert ISBN-10 to ISBN-13, UPC-E to UPC-A, or UPC-A to EAN-13/GTIN-14. Explains the check-digit arithmetic, gives the corrected number and the GS1 prefix meaning. Does not tell who owns a number, whether it is registered with GS1, or what product it is; does not look anything up online.

number.description: The number to check, e.g. 5901234123457, 036000291452, 0-306-40615-2 (ISBN-10), 0317-8471 (ISSN) or 106141412345678908 (SSCC). Spaces and hyphens are ignored. Without its check digit (e.g. 03600029145) the check digit is computed.

type.description: Number type, e.g. auto (default: detected from the length). gtin8, gtin12 (UPC-A), gtin13 (EAN-13), gtin14, sscc, upce, isbn10, isbn13, issn. Use upce or issn for 8-digit numbers that are not EAN-8.

name: validate_barcode_number
title: Validate barcode number
